lines.zh: 我在冰海里慢慢游，头顶着冰。
lines.en: I swim the icy sea, my head against the ice.

lines.zh: 我一顶，冰层裂开一条缝。
lines.en: One push and the ice splits along a seam.

lines.zh: 我贴着冰底走，找薄的地方。
lines.en: I travel under the ice, looking for thin spots.

lines.zh: 我摆尾很慢，水被压得很实。
lines.en: My tail beats slowly and the water presses close.

lines.zh: 我从冰洞口探出去，吸了口气。
lines.en: I put my head through a hole and take a breath.

lines.zh: 我绕开厚冰，朝薄的地方去。
lines.en: I avoid the thick ice and head for thin.

lines.zh: 我用头顶磕，磕出一个小孔。
lines.en: I butt upward and break a small hole.

lines.zh: 我沿着冰缘游，慢慢走。
lines.en: I travel the ice edge, slowly.

lines.zh: 我经过你的雪橇旁边，雪橇晃了。
lines.en: I pass your sled and it rocks.

lines.zh: 我一步一步往前，冰在头上碎。
lines.en: I push on as the ice breaks overhead.

lines.zh: 我朝你那边游，水很凉。
lines.en: I swim your way through cold water.

lines.zh: 我从冰缝里钻出来一点。
lines.en: I nose partway out of an ice crack.

lines.zh: 我的背拱起来，撞了一下冰。
lines.en: My back arches and strikes the ice.

lines.zh: 我慢慢沉下去，找另一条路。
lines.en: I sink slowly to find another way.

lines.zh: 我顺着冰下的暗流走。
lines.en: I ride the undercurrent beneath the ice.

lines.zh: 我顶开一块浮冰，浮冰滑走了。
lines.en: I shove a floe aside and it slides away.

lines.zh: 我朝远处游，冰在头顶连成一片。
lines.en: I swim on under unbroken ice.

lines.zh: 我升上来，石头一般的前额先出水。
lines.en: I rise with my stone-hard brow breaking first.

lines.zh: 我浮在冰洞口，慢慢呼吸。
lines.en: I float at the breathing hole, breathing slowly.

lines.zh: 我不动，冰下的水很稳。
lines.en: I hold still and the water under the ice is calm.

lines.zh: 我把头搁在冰沿上，歇着。
lines.en: I rest my head on the ice rim.

lines.zh: 我悬在冰层下面，尾几乎不动。
lines.en: I hang beneath the ice, tail nearly still.

lines.zh: 我喷出一口气，雾在冰上散开。
lines.en: I blow out and mist spreads on the ice.

lines.zh: 我安静地浮着，身上有旧伤。
lines.en: I float quietly, carrying old scars.

lines.zh: 我慢慢侧过身，让水流过。
lines.en: I turn on my side and let the water pass.

lines.zh: 我听着冰层里的挤压声。
lines.en: I listen to the ice grinding.

lines.zh: 我沉下去，光一点点没了。
lines.en: I sink and the light goes.

lines.zh: 我张口吞了一大口水。
lines.en: I open my mouth for a great mouthful.

lines.zh: 我在冰下慢慢打转。
lines.en: I turn slowly under the ice.

lines.zh: 我伏着，身上的藤壶很厚。
lines.en: I rest with thick barnacles on me.

lines.zh: 我等一个冰口子化开。
lines.en: I wait for a gap to open in the ice.

lines.zh: 我安静下来，呼吸声像风。
lines.en: I go quiet, my breath like wind.

lines.zh: 我从冰洞里看你，只露出眼睛。
lines.en: I watch you from the hole with only my eyes out.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，我喷了一口气。
lines.en: You crouch and I blow out a breath.

lines.zh: 我额前那块硬皮慢慢转向你。
lines.en: The hard brow plate turns slowly toward you.

lines.zh: 你的灯照在冰口，我眼里亮了一下。
lines.en: Your lamp finds the hole and my eye glints.

lines.zh: 你退开几步，我还从冰口望着。
lines.en: You step back and I keep watching from the hole.

lines.zh: 你手伸到冰口，我把额头送过去。
lines.en: Your hand comes to the hole and I offer my brow.

lines.zh: 我一直朝你那边，没有敌意。
lines.en: I stay turned to you without malice.

lines.zh: 你喊了一声，我把头抬高。
lines.en: You call and I lift my head.

lines.zh: 你的目光落下来，我连鳍都没动。
lines.en: Your gaze falls on me and even my flipper stays still.

lines.zh: 你走开，我才慢慢沉下去。
lines.en: You walk off and only then do I sink.

lines.zh: 我被打中，冰上留下一片红。
lines.en: Hit, red shows on the ice.

lines.zh: 我用头骨顶开冰面。
lines.en: I break the ice with my skull.

lines.zh: 我不出声，只有呼吸变重。
lines.en: I make no sound; only my breathing deepens.

lines.zh: 我退到冰壁边，还朝你。
lines.en: I retreat to the ice wall, still facing you.

lines.zh: 伤口泡在冰水里，慢慢不再渗。
lines.en: The wound soaks in the icy water and stops seeping.

lines.zh: 我顶开冰，换了口气。
lines.en: I break the ice and take a breath.

lines.zh: 我侧过身，冰下大片的水被挤开。
lines.en: I turn on my side and a mass of water shoves away.

lines.zh: 我贴着冰底歇了一会儿。
lines.en: I rest against the underside of the ice.

lines.zh: 我从冰口抬头，一只眼仍朝你。
lines.en: I lift through the hole with one eye still on you.

lines.zh: 我绕着冰柱游了一圈回来。
lines.en: I circle an ice pillar and come back.

lines.zh: 你丢下小鱼，我慢慢游过来。
lines.en: You drop small fish and I come slowly.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴，把水和鱼一起吞。
lines.en: I open my mouth and take water and fish.

lines.zh: 你举过头顶，我这身子够不上。
lines.en: You hold it overhead and this body cannot reach.

lines.zh: 我吃完抬头，还想要。
lines.en: I lift my head and want more.

lines.zh: 你收手，我停在冰口边。
lines.en: You pull back and I stop at the hole.

lines.zh: 我更喜欢成群的浮游小虾。
lines.en: I prefer swarms of tiny krill.

lines.zh: 你把鱼撒开，我一口口滤。
lines.en: You scatter the fish and I strain them up.

lines.zh: 你走开了，我还待在冰口下那片水。
lines.en: You walk off and I stay in the water under the hole.

lines.zh: 我吃得很慢，很稳。
lines.en: I eat slowly and steadily.

lines.zh: 你走了，我把冰口顶大一点。
lines.en: You leave and I widen the hole a little.

lines.zh: 你撞上我，像撞上一块礁。
lines.en: You hit me like a reef.

lines.zh: 我一顶，你退到冰沿上。
lines.en: One push and you are at the ice rim.

lines.zh: 我擦过船帮，船被推得偏了。
lines.en: I scrape the gunwale and the boat swings off.

lines.zh: 你推过来，我这截身子几乎没挪。
lines.en: You push and this bulk of mine hardly shifts.

lines.zh: 我挡在冰口，你出不去。
lines.en: I fill the breathing hole and you cannot pass.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，冰裂了一块。
lines.en: We collide and a piece of ice splits.

lines.zh: 你踏在我背上，脚底打了下滑。
lines.en: You step on my back and your foot slips.

lines.zh: 我把你挤到冰壁边。
lines.en: I crowd you against the ice wall.

lines.zh: 经过时水推着你转。
lines.en: As I pass, the water spins you.

lines.zh: 我沉下去，让出一条道。
lines.en: I sink and open a way.

lines.zh: 另一头弓头鲸从冰下浮出。
lines.en: Another bowhead rises from under the ice.

lines.zh: 我们并排浮着，慢慢呼吸。
lines.en: We float side by side, breathing slowly.

lines.zh: 它的前额比我的更白。
lines.en: Its brow is whiter than mine.

lines.zh: 我们一起顶开一块冰。
lines.en: We push a sheet of ice open together.

lines.zh: 它贴到我身侧，冰水被挤开。
lines.en: It presses to my flank and the cold water parts.

lines.zh: 我们一起沉下去，冰又合上。
lines.en: We sink and the ice closes over.

lines.zh: 它低低地叫，我也应了一声。
lines.en: It calls low and I answer once.

lines.zh: 它先游开，往厚冰那边。
lines.en: It swims off toward the thick ice.

lines.zh: 我留在洞口，慢慢呼吸。
lines.en: I stay at the hole, breathing slowly.

lines.zh: 冰下多了一道很长的影。
lines.en: A long shadow joins those under the ice.

lines.zh: 你抓住我的鳍，我纹丝不动。
lines.en: You grab my fin; I don't budge.

lines.zh: 你抓住我胸鳍，被拖得往前滑。
lines.en: You grip my flipper and are dragged forward.

lines.zh: 你想抬我，手臂都绷白了也没用。
lines.en: You try to lift me and your arms strain for nothing.

lines.zh: 你按我的头，我慢慢抬起来。
lines.en: You press my head and I lift it slowly.

lines.zh: 你贴着我的背，冰水很凉。
lines.en: You lie along my back in the cold water.

lines.zh: 你松开手，我一点点沉回冰下。
lines.en: You let go and I sink back under the ice.

lines.zh: 你拉着绳子，我带着你走。
lines.en: You hold the rope and I tow you.

lines.zh: 你摸我前额的硬皮。
lines.en: You touch the hard skin of my brow.

lines.zh: 你退开，我顶了一下冰。
lines.en: You back off and I butt the ice.

lines.zh: 你把灯移开，我慢慢游走。
lines.en: You move the lamp and I swim off.

lines.zh: 冰下的水一动，我就转过头。
lines.en: The water stirs under the ice and I turn my head.

lines.zh: 我朝那边游，很慢。
lines.en: I swim that way, slowly.

lines.zh: 我对着冰层，把额头顶上去。
lines.en: I press my forehead up against the ice.

lines.zh: 我选定方向，摆了一下尾。
lines.en: I pick a heading and beat my tail once.

lines.zh: 你身边的水变了，我过去了。
lines.en: The water near you changes and I move over.

lines.zh: 我对着那边看，没有挪开眼。
lines.en: I keep my eyes there without turning away.

lines.zh: 我认准了，就慢慢靠近。
lines.en: I fix on it and close in slowly.

lines.zh: 我把冰顶开，朝你游。
lines.en: I break the ice open and swim your way.

lines.zh: 我发出很长的声音，那是信号。
lines.en: I send a long call, and that is the signal.

lines.zh: 我顶开浮冰，朝你的声音去。
lines.en: I push through drift ice toward your voice.

lines.zh: 我顺着那个方向，慢慢推水过去。
lines.en: I push slowly through the water on that heading.

lines.zh: 它从冰口游开，我慢慢跟上去。
lines.en: It leaves the hole and I follow slowly.

lines.zh: 方向没偏，冰在头上一直没断。
lines.en: My heading holds beneath unbroken ice.

lines.zh: 我贴着冰底跟过去。
lines.en: I track along beneath the ice.

lines.zh: 它躲到冰柱后，我绕过去。
lines.en: It hides behind an ice pillar and I go round.

lines.zh: 我一点点靠近，冰在头上。
lines.en: I close in with the ice overhead.

lines.zh: 它一停下，我的尾就不再摆。
lines.en: It halts and my tail stops beating.

lines.zh: 冰下的水缝，我一路跟着。
lines.en: I follow the water seam beneath the ice.

lines.zh: 我撞开浮冰，继续走。
lines.en: I break a floe aside and keep going.

lines.zh: 我一直朝你，慢慢转正。
lines.en: I keep to you and slowly square up.

lines.zh: 我一头顶上去，冰都碎了。
lines.en: I drive my head up and the ice breaks.

lines.zh: 我一甩尾，把水推成一道墙。
lines.en: My tail sweeps and the water becomes a wall.

lines.zh: 我一头顶过去，船底被撞裂。
lines.en: I drive my brow up and the hull splits.

lines.zh: 我压过去，把你挤在冰上。
lines.en: I press in and pin you against the ice.

lines.zh: 我猛地撞它的侧腹，冰水震荡。
lines.en: I ram its flank and the cold water shakes.

lines.zh: 我用前额顶开挡路的冰。
lines.en: I butt the blocking ice aside.

lines.zh: 我一下撞空，撞在礁上。
lines.en: I miss and strike the reef.

lines.zh: 我用前额把它顶进冰层底下。
lines.en: My brow shoves it under the ice.

lines.zh: 我摆尾扫过，水把你推倒。
lines.en: My tail sweeps and the water knocks you down.

lines.zh: 我撞一下就退，绕回来。
lines.en: I hit once, withdraw, and circle back.

lines.zh: 冰面下浮起一头，是我。
lines.en: Something rises beneath the ice, and it is me.

lines.zh: 刷怪蛋落进冰水，我慢慢上来。
lines.en: The spawn egg drops into icy water and I rise slowly.

lines.zh: 你听见冰被顶的声音。
lines.en: You hear the ice being pushed.

lines.zh: 我从冰洞里露出前额。
lines.en: I show my brow through a breathing hole.

lines.zh: 冰海里多了一道很长的影。
lines.en: A long shadow joins the icy sea.

lines.zh: 你回头看，冰面上多了一个口子。
lines.en: You look back and there is a new hole in the ice.

lines.zh: 我从远处游来，慢慢靠近。
lines.en: I swim in from afar, slowly.

lines.zh: 冰裂开一道，我上来了。
lines.en: The ice splits and I come up.

lines.zh: 这片冰海一直很静，现在有声音。
lines.en: This icy sea was quiet; now it has a voice.

lines.zh: 我从冰层下面转出来。
lines.en: I come round from under the ice.

lines.zh: 冰面烧起火，我立刻往下沉。
lines.en: Fire burns on the ice and I dive at once.

lines.zh: 我被浪推上冰面，摔得很重。
lines.en: The swell throws me onto the ice.

lines.zh: 冰下没有气，我拼命往上顶。
lines.en: No air under the ice and I push hard upward.

lines.zh: 爆炸在冰下闷响，我被推得撞上冰层。
lines.en: The blast thuds below and drives me into the ice.

lines.zh: 鱼叉戳在我背甲上，只进了半分。
lines.en: The harpoon bites my back plate half an inch.

lines.zh: 药水的光在冰下亮起，我慢慢退。
lines.en: The potion's glow lights under the ice and I back off.

lines.zh: 冰下的小虾很少，我没力气。
lines.en: Krill are scarce under the ice and my strength fails.

lines.zh: 雷落在冰盖上，冰下的我全身发木。
lines.en: Lightning hits the ice above and my whole body goes wooden.

lines.zh: 我下沉，头顶那片冰也消失了。
lines.en: I sink and the sheet of ice above is gone.
